upstream.subject: Refine mobile community switching and discovery (#2967)
upstream.reason: Mobile remains a separate post-beta proof lane.

upstream.subject: fix(desktop): strip legacy baked team instructions from stored prompts (#3035)

upstream.reason: Use the new upstream generic runtime seam to shrink the Hermes adapter while preserving dependency-readiness versus ACP-authentication separation.

upstream.subject: fix(desktop): render rich project work item content (#3100)

upstream.subject: fix(mobile): mitigate message-post delay with optimistic rendering (#3037)
upstream.reason: Mobile remains outside the current internal desktop beta.
